interface_debt.why: The field width is taken from a mission configuration macro, so the struct size and tool-visible layout differ between mission configurations and change if that configuration value changes, forcing coordinated updates to elf2cfetbl and all table definitions.
interface_debt.better: Use a fixed stable maximum in the public contract, or store a length-prefixed variable-length name in the serialized format rather than a configuration-dependent fixed array.
interface_debt.title: cFE:fsw/cfe-core/src/inc/cfe_tbl_filedef.h: TableName — users reach into the layout of a type (public struct or union members)

interface_debt.quote: char ObjectName[64]; /**< \brief Name of instantiated variable that contains desired table image
interface_debt.why: A fixed 64-byte name field freezes the layout and limits object names to 63 characters; if cFE later supports longer symbol names or a different naming scheme, existing table images and elf2cfetbl parsing break.
interface_debt.better: Use a length-prefixed or versioned name representation, or expose the name through a stable accessor or serialization API instead of a raw fixed-size array.
